page.content:
Argentina's 2022 captain who closed the one missing prize.

How Lionel Messi connects

  • Faction: Argentina national team — Messi captained Argentina to the 2022 World Cup.
  • Event: 2022 FIFA World Cup — Messi won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina in Qatar.
  • Item: FIFA World Cup Trophy — Messi lifted the FIFA World Cup Trophy in 2022.
  • Character: Diego Maradona — Messi's 2022 title is told as the closing of Maradona's 1986 myth.

What is Lionel Messi?

Lionel Messi won the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, scoring in the final against France and ending the argument that his career lacked the trophy Maradona had.

Key threads lead to Argentina national team, 2022 FIFA World Cup, FIFA World Cup Trophy and Diego Maradona.
